definitions.explanation: The inside of a company or organization. Used as a noun or as a prefix to describe things that are internal to a company, such as rules, events, or communication.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To send an internal company email.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}ら→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: You must follow the company's internal rules.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}{研修|けんしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to use the new system at an in-house training session.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company) and ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside). Frequently used as a prefix to describe things internal to a company or organization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社内|しゃない}{規定|きてい}: company regulations
- {社内|しゃない}{研修|けんしゅう}: in-house training
- {社内|しゃない}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: internal report
- {社内|しゃない}⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧: office romance
- {社内|しゃない}⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: internal email

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {社内|しゃない}: within the company
- ⟦{社外|しゃがい}→社外：17992_shagai⟧: outside the company

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧ (inside a vehicle), which has the same reading but uses different kanji.

SIMILAR ～{内|ない} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{校内|こうない}→校内：26870_kounai⟧: within the school
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧: domestic, within the country
- ⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧: within the city
